address: 36-40 Rupert Street, Soho, London, W1D 6DW, United Kingdom
bio: Fans of Thai-food legend David Thompson were delighted when his residency in Soho became a permanent fixture. Long Chim means ‘come and try’ and the open kitchen delivers an appetising range of dishes. All regions of Thailand are represented, from the North to the East, from the Central Region to the deep South. Don’t hold back on ordering and don’t miss the spicy pork with crunchy rice cakes, the monkfish curry with cucumber relish or the red curry of chicken with ginger and green beans. The colourful room is run by a warm and friendly team....
